snippet.title: Galaxian 3 - Arcade Laserdisc Playthrough Part 1 (1995 High Quality 60FPS Namco Footage)
snippet.description:
This is part 1 of "Galaxian 3" (VILL-101, 1995) which is a Laserdisc containing a playthrough & soundtrack of the original arcade "Theater 6" version of Namco's Galaxian 3. This (like nearly all playthrough discs) was only sold in Japan. The idea for playthough Laserdiscs and VHS tapes was a bit like the modern "Let's Play" or speedrun. The footage runs through levels by an experienced player or one of the game designers who then exposes shortcuts, tips, & tricks which you could then exploit the next time you visited the arcade!

This side covers the original "Project Dragoon" quest released in 1992.

Enjoy the unique "extra wide" Theater 6 graphics and exclusive jazz-fusion-y soundtrack!

________________________________________________

Chapter List:
00:00 - GRAND OPENING
01:56 - PROLOGUE OF M8774E
04:15 - GUNNER ENTRY
04:53 - "DRAGOON" DEPARTURE
05:26 - ASTEROID AREA
05:54 - BATTLESHIPS AREA
06:31 - APPROACH "DOLDVA"
07:48 - BATTLE ON "DOGMAS"
09:02 - RUSH INTO "CANNON SEED"
10:02 - ATTACK "SPARK-BIT"
10:37 - MISSION COMPLETED
12:39 - CHARACTER DATA
16:26 - FAILURE "ASTEROID BASE"
17:00 - FAILURE "HAMMER-HEAD"
17:14 - FAILURE "DOLDVA"
19:59 - FAILURE "SPARK-BIT"
20:41 - MISSION UNSUCCESSFUL

________________________________________________

This was played using a Pioneer HLD-X0 laserdisc player.

________________________________________________

Be sure to check out part 2 here: https://youtu.be/QeEdRQzTqcM

Content aware ultra-wide crop by @doctordothraki4378 here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uHIMumv3GEM
